title: CDW to Participate in the J.P. Morgan 2026 Global Technology, Media & Communications Conference
summary: CDW Corporation (Nasdaq: CDW) today announced that Christine A. Leahy, chair and chief executive officer, and Albert J. Miralles, chief financial officer and executive vice president, enterprise business operations, CDW, will participate in a question and answer session at the J.P. Morgan 2026 Global Technology, Media and Communications Conference in Boston, Massachusetts on Tuesday, May 19, 2025, at 10:25 a.m. CT/11:25 a.m. ET. The session will be webcast live on investor.cdw.com . An archived copy of the webcast will be available on the same website for 30 days following the completion of the event. About CDW CDW Corporation is a leading multi-brand provider of information technology solutions to business, government, education and healthcare customers in the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada. A Fortune 500 company and member of the SP 500 Index, CDW helps its customers to navigate an increasingly complex IT market and maximize return on their technology investments.
